# astro_ai_spending_caps (Resource)

Manage an organization's per-user and per-API-token Astro AI spending caps as a single resource: the default cap for users, the default cap for API tokens, and the own cap of each user and API token. A cap is a monthly limit in USD cents on Astro AI spend, and an own cap replaces the default for that user or API token. `0` turns AI off.

~> **Labs.** The AI spending caps API is a Labs feature, turned on per organization. If it is not turned on for your organization, every request fails with a "not available" error.

~> **Warning: authoritative maps.** When `user_cap_cents` or `api_token_cap_cents` is set, any user or API token with a cap of its own that is not in the map has it removed on apply, including caps set in the Astro UI. A removed cap makes the user or API token follow the default, and a default of `0` turns AI off for them. Leave a map unset to leave that kind of cap to the Astro UI, and use at most one `astro_ai_spending_caps` resource.

~> **Note** Destroying this resource removes the defaults and caps it manages, so those users and API tokens have no limit of their own afterwards. The organization-wide AI spending cap is not managed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The astro_ai_spending_caps resource manages an organization's per-user and per-API-token Astro AI
# spending caps as a single resource. Amounts are monthly limits in USD cents.
#
# Every attribute is optional, and one that is not set is not managed. A map that is set is
# authoritative: a user or API token with a cap of its own that is not in it has the cap removed on
# apply, including one set in the Astro UI. Use at most one astro_ai_spending_caps resource.
#
# The AI spending caps API is a Labs feature that Astro turns on per organization.

resource "astro_ai_spending_caps" "org" {
  # The default for every user and every API token without a cap of their own.
  default_user_cap_cents      = 5000 # $50
  default_api_token_cap_cents = 2500 # $25

  # An own cap replaces the default for that user or API token, higher or lower, and 0 turns AI off
  # for it. The keys are user IDs and API token IDs.
  user_cap_cents = {
    "clm8q7f6q000008lcgyougpsk" = 20000 # $200
    "clm8q8c1x000108lc1w2h5p9d" = 0     # no AI for this user
  }

  api_token_cap_cents = {
    "clm8pxjjw000008l23jm08hyu" = 10000 # $100
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token_cap_cents` (Map of Number) The own monthly AI spending cap of each API token, in USD cents, keyed by API token ID. It works like `user_cap_cents`, for API tokens: authoritative when set, `0` turns AI off for the API token, and not managed when unset.
- `default_api_token_cap_cents` (Number) The default monthly AI spending cap, in USD cents, for every API token without a cap of its own in `api_token_cap_cents`. Set independently of the user default. At most `10000000` ($100,000). `0` turns AI off for those API tokens. If unset, the default is not managed by this resource. If it was set and is removed from the configuration, the default is removed.
- `default_user_cap_cents` (Number) The default monthly AI spending cap, in USD cents, for every user without a cap of their own in `user_cap_cents`. At most `10000000` ($100,000). `0` turns AI off for those users. If unset, the default is not managed by this resource. If it was set and is removed from the configuration, the default is removed.
- `user_cap_cents` (Map of Number) The own monthly AI spending cap of each user, in USD cents, keyed by user ID. A user's own cap replaces the user default for them, higher or lower; `0` turns AI off for the user. At most `10000000` ($100,000) each. When set, this attribute is authoritative for the organization's users: a user with a cap of their own that is not in the map has it removed on apply, including one set in the Astro UI. Set it to `{}` to remove every user's own cap. If unset, users' caps are not managed by this resource. If it was set and is removed from the configuration, the caps it held are removed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization whose AI spending caps this resource manages. This is also the ID used to import the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The AI spending caps are a singleton per organization. Import them using the organization ID. The
# provider reads both defaults, when they are set, and every user's and API token's own cap into the
# resource, so the configuration then has to list the defaults and caps you keep: an attribute
# missing from it is removed on the next apply.
terraform import astro_ai_spending_caps.org <organization_id>
```
